headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: Six years after split, BJP and Akali Dal reunite for Punjab elections.
Dhanush’s welfare movement plans expansion ahead of 2027 local body polls.
FIR Filed Against TVK MLA Arul Vignesh Over Obscene Messages.
bullets_ur: Cheh saal pehle alag hone ke baad BJP aur Akali Dal ne Punjab chunaav ke liye ittehad kar liya
Dhanush ki khairiyati tehreek 2027 ke mukami intikhabat se pehle wasoo ka irada
Fahash messages bhejne par TVK ke MLA Arul Vignesh ke khilaf FIR darj kar li gayi.
